title: 第一卷 第13章 死性不改周德厚！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

没想到在自己外出期间，周德厚这个老不死的，居然又跑到他家里来，想要骚扰赵佛儿。

想来也是不甘心，就这样吃下这么个大亏。

再加上赵佛儿经过洗漱之后所呈现出来的容貌绝非一般女子所能够比拟的，今早那件事情过后，村里就有不少人在议论着赵佛儿的姿色。

周德厚的好色是全青石沟出了名的，据说连睡觉都要有两个丫鬟给他暖脚。

可以说，这家伙纯粹是把自己当作青石沟的土皇帝。

否则也不会一直压榨青石沟的汉人！

因为他很清楚自己土皇帝的地位来自金兵老爷。

院子里，周德厚见赵佛儿没有理会自己，不仅不感到尴尬，甚至还再度开口。

“你一个菜人，可别给脸不要脸，老夫家里虽说算不上大富大贵，好歹也是个里长，你要是愿意……”

周德厚话说到最后，甚至带起了几分威胁的意味。

显然是想通过抢走秦云的女人来找回自己的场子，不过他的话还没有说完，秦云的声音便是传了过来。

“周里长，没想到你还有骚扰良家妇女的习惯，不过，我的媳妇可不愿意跟你这种人在一起。”

伴随着秦云的声音传来，也是把周德厚吓了一个激灵，很显然他并没有想到秦云会在这个时候回来。

随即也是回过身来，就看见秦云正站在他的身后，一脸冷笑地看着自己。

由于近距离杀野猪的缘故，秦云虽然用雪擦拭了一下全身的血，但浑身上下都还是糊了一层猪血。

可以说整个人都是血人，但那双满是冷冰之意的瞳孔，此时正牢牢地锁定在周德厚的身上。

着实是把周德厚给吓了个半死。

周德后被吓了一跳后，目光也随之看向了秦云身后的简易担架。

上面还拖着一头将近200斤的野猪尸体，这在周德厚看来简直是难以置信。

秦云，居然杀了头野猪回来？

“秦云啊，你不是进山打猎了吗，看你这样子，这一趟进山打猎的收获还挺不错的。”

周德厚被人逮了个现行，当下也显得有些尴尬。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Unexpectedly, while he was out, Zhou Dehou, an old man, actually came to his house again and wanted to harass Zhao Fo'er.

Thinking about it, I couldn't bear to suffer such a big loss like this.

In addition, Zhao Foer's appearance after washing was definitely beyond the comparison of ordinary women. After the incident this morning, many people in the village were talking about Zhao Foer's beauty.

Zhou Dehou was famous throughout Qingshigou for his lustful nature. It was said that he had to have two maids to warm his feet even when he slept.

It can be said that this guy simply regards himself as the local emperor of Qingshigou.

Otherwise, the Han people in Qingshigou would not have been exploited!

Because he knew very well that his status as a local emperor came from Master Jin Bing.

In the yard, Zhou Dehou saw that Zhao Foer ignored him. Not only did he not feel embarrassed, he even spoke again.

"You are a dishonest person, so don't be shameless. Although my family is not rich, I am still a boss. If you are willing..."

At the end of Zhou Dehou's words, he even sounded a bit threatening.

Obviously he wanted to regain his position by snatching Qin Yun's woman, but before he finished speaking, Qin Yun's voice came over.

"Zhou Lichang, I didn't expect you to have the habit of harassing women from good families, but my wife is not willing to be with someone like you."

The sound of Qin Yun's voice frightened Zhou Dehou. Obviously, he did not expect Qin Yun to come back at this time.

Then he turned around and saw Qin Yun standing behind him, looking at him with a sneer.

Because he killed a wild boar at close range, Qin Yun wiped the blood all over his body with snow, but there was still a layer of pig blood all over his body.

It can be said that the whole person is a bloody person, but those eyes full of coldness are firmly locked on Zhou Dehou.

It really scared Zhou Dehou half to death.

After Zhou Dehou was startled, he looked at the simple stretcher behind Qin Yun.

There was also a wild boar carcass weighing nearly 200 kilograms dragged on top, which seemed unbelievable to Zhou Dehou.

Qin Yun actually killed a wild boar and came back?

"Qin Yun, didn't you go into the mountains to hunt? Looking at you, the harvest from this hunting trip into the mountains was pretty good."

Zhou Dehou was caught in action and seemed a little embarrassed at the moment.
